quarterly_data.quarter: Uber press release: Wayve and Uber Launch First-Ever Autonomous Rides in the UK (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Wayve: Uber and Wayve launched supervised autonomous rides in London on September 3, 2026 - the first autonomous trips available in the UK (company claim) - in all-electric Ford Mustang Mach-E vehicles equipped with the Wayve AI Driver and surround sensors, with a trained TfL-licensed private hire driver onboard, starting with a small number of vehicles; over 140,000 Londoners have already opted in. The launch is part of the Uber-Wayve partnership, which included an investment to put Wayve-powered vehicles on the Uber network in 12 markets around the world, beginning with London; the Nissan LEAF powered by the Wayve AI Driver using NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion is to start in Tokyo later this year. Uber states that by 2029 it intends to be the largest facilitator of AV trips in the world.
quarterly_data.figure: 12 markets; over 140,000 Londoners opted in; Tokyo later this year; largest facilitator of AV trips by 2029
